q1_issues.issue: The sealed antecedent (And (Member sk_air_1 air)) records "there IS air", dropping the antecedent's negation ("if there were NO air") and asserting the positive form in its place — the registered seal-polarity limitation explicitly says an unexpressible negated conjunct must be left out, never replaced by its positive.
The sealed consequent carries a bare (Can sk_live_1) with no polarity carrier, so it records "people could live for ten minutes" — the opposite of the stated "could not live".

(Member sk_air_1 air) asserts at strength 1.0 that air exists; the counterfactual recipe calls for the ANTECEDENT proposition emitted as a strength-0.0 bundle, and the text asserts no such positive fact.
(Even 10 sk_live_1) uses the bare numeral 10 as the focus filler, where a focus filler is specified to be the focused constituent's symbol or, for predicate focus, the verb-class lemma.
(Experiencer sk_live_1 sk_people_1) contradicts the instruction set's own worked example for this verb ("Mia has lived in Oslo since 2019" -> (Agent sk_live_1 mia)).

The bare plural "people" is given a definite-style group witness (GroupOf sk_people_1 person); a bare plural is the generic on the determiner test, and group witnesses are for definite / demonstrative / possessed plurals.

q2_gaps: negated-antecedent conditional ("if there were no air") — the instruction set states outright that "unless X" / "if not X" is not yet supported, and gives no way to record a negative antecedent, which is what forced this parse to invert the polarity
"were"-subjunctive present counterfactual — Counterfactual is specified only for the past "if X had V-ed, Y would have V-ed" form, and an indicative Implication is explicitly the wrong route here
the counterfactual presupposition recipe collides with a negative antecedent: emitting "the antecedent proposition at strength 0.0" would double-negate "there is no air"
negation inside a seal generally — a sealed clause has no polarity carrier, so a negated consequent ("could not live") is unrepresentable
scalar minimizer "not even ten minutes" — "even" scoping over a measured duration under negation has no licensed filler (there is no symbol for the duration to focus on)
notes: Both halves of the counterfactual are polarity-inverted inside the seal and the presupposition is asserted positively at strength 1.0, so the recorded content is the opposite of the sentence on every contentful point; the duration measure is the one part in the specified form.
